Demonstration of quoted model is mandatory (if required) Required Technical Specification MEDICAL AIR COMPRESSOR SYSTEM Air compressor system would be installed separately based on late st advanced technology. The complete compressed air system shal l be designed, manufactured, tested, and commissioned in complia nce with the latest applicable international standards EN/DIN/NFPA- 99/ISO7396/HTM 02-01 certification. The system shall ensure delivery of clean, dry, oil-free compressed air suitable for medical applications, with all necessary safety featu res, and monitoring systems as per the above international standar ds. Medical air quality to the European pharmacopeia Monograph s hould be delivering at 5 bar gauge for central supply pipeline syste m to the hospital. Following features/specifications are required: 1. Compressor Type: Oil-free reciprocating / rotary screw / scroll type. Medical air should be clean, dry, and oil-free. It should give guarantee that no oil will enter the medical air from compres sor system. Zero oil means zero risk of contamination to be certified 100% oil free. 2. Capacity: Stable pressure required at 5 bar. Compressor should be free air delivery minimum 1500 LPM @ 8.5 kg/cm ² pressure or 60 CFM (as per ISO1217). 3. Cooling System: Air-cooled compressor. Compressor should be supplied with block and fin style after cooler with a dedicated quiet running fan to maximize cooling and efficiency.

4. Motor Specification: 3 Phase power supply. Electric motor should be 15 HP, V belt driven with efficiency IE3& mainten ance free. Motor shall be 1500 RPM with Star-Delta control, complete with switchgear and overload protection. 5. Air Receiver Tank: 500 Liters horizontal type. Compressor should be fitted on a horizontal tank mounted (500 Ltr), ASME coded with safety valve & drainage valve. 6. Dryer & Filtration: Desiccant dryer should be required. Moisture and bacteria removal filters. 80 to 100 CFM air dryer and three stage air filtration system would be requ ired. Dryer shall be of heatless twin tower type, capable of achieving a pressure dew point (PDP) of 67 PPM / -46°C for ensuring dry compressed air. Pre-filter: 5 micron, After-filter: 5 micron, suitable for a working pressure of 10 kg/cm². 7. Capacity Control: Two step capacity controls 0–100% with load/unload pressure switch & sol enoid valve. Suitable for continuous and frequently start/stop. 8. Safety Features: Safety valve. Pressure switch (auto cut-off). Fully automatic operation. 9. Pipeline: Copper piping with silver brazing, leak-proof system. The copper pipe for medical air system should be Lloyd Certified (As per B S 2871). Copper pipe shall be half hard, solid drawn, seamless, tempered, de-oxidiz

ed, non-arsenic and fully de-greased conforming to BS-EN 1057 OR BS-E N 13348:2008 standard and CE mark. The pipe will be accompanied with manufacturers test certificate for the ph ysical properties & chemical composition as per BS 6017:1981 and manu factured as per BS:2871 Part-1. All joints shall be made of copper and brazed by silver brazing filler materia ls without use of any flux. Brazing Rod – CP 104 (5% silver – copper phosphorous brazing alloy) . Copper to brass or gunmetal – brazing Rod AC 203 (43% silver – copper – zinc brazing alloy) as per EN 1044 standard. Fittings, as required for jointing in pipe carcass, shall be end-feed capillary fittings of Medical Grade Copper, which conform to EN 1254-1. British Standard (BS) 2871 British Standard (BS) 2871 specifies the dimensions, mechanical pr operties, and testing requirements for copper and copper alloy tub es used in water, gas, sanitation, and general engineering applicati ons. It provides detailed guidelines regarding the material composi tion, including Cu-DHP (phosphorus-deoxidized copper), and classifi es the tubes into designated tables such as Table W, Table X, and Table Y based on different wall thicknesses and tempers. Although BS 2871 has been withdrawn and has largely been superseded by European standards such as EN 1057 (for water and gas applicatio ns) and EN 12449/EN 12451, it continues to serve as a reference st andard for legacy piping systems. The standard outlines the essent ial requirements relating to material quality, dimensions, manufact uring, and testing of copper tubes used in piping installations. All type Site plan and system layout plan including of civil, electrical and mec hanical work for installation, testing & commissioning of Medical Air Compressor System and its related accessories will be scope of Bidder/Tenderer. 5. Annual testing of safety valve and color coding of the vessel should be scope of the supplier. 6. Hospital staff to be trained for day to day monitoring, operation & emergency will be scope of supplier. 7. Installation & Commissioning means Supply, Installation, testing and Commis sioning and satisfactory demonstration & training to staff to operate of the whol e system as per the specifications ordered for mention in the Work order. 8. Pre installation requirements: - The Technical Bid must contain details with sp ecification of items required for installation PRE-INSTALLATION REQUIREMENTS i .e. AIR / WATER/ ELECTRICAL POWER / TEMPERATURE & HUMIDITY CONTROL / F OUNDATION / SPACE and any other requirements to complete work /project at B MHRC, Bhopal. 9. Tenderer/Bidder should have 05 Years experience in the field of supply and in stallation of Medical Air Compressor System in the Hospitals. 10. Tenderer/ Bidder should enclose list of hospitals with years of installation for the last five years. 11. Tender for supply of medical air compressor system work on TRC basis. 12. Air Compressor Unit must be isolated from mechanical vibration. 13. The scope of work shall include supply, installation, testing & commissioning of satisfactory performance. This shall also include testing, packing, transportation, delivery at sites, unloading job site storage, installation and any other services associated with the delivery of equipment and materials providing warranty of services & maintenances of other related equipment. 14. Tenderer are required to have a survey including a site visit before furnishin g the Bid. 15. Leaflets, equipment manuals (hard copy), CD, DVD etc. and literature shoul d be attached for ready reference along with complete documents of all the me asurements conducts during installation period which shall be submitted by the supplier for future reference. 16. Before the equipment is taken over by purchase, the supplier shall provide manuals of the equipment/systems. This shall include the following:-

a. System interface drawing wiring diagrams. b. System interconnection and block diagrams. c. User Operational manuals. d. Equipment maintenance manuals. 17. Erection, Commissioning of Medical Air Compressor System with related equ ipments and interconnecting pipeline in to our existing central pipeline system i s in supplier scope. . 24.
